question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 L 组：英格兰 vs 加纳，90 分钟赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group L: England vs Ghana, 90-minute result?
one_liner_cn: 英格兰实力碾压且阵容齐整，加纳缺少库杜斯又状态低迷，英格兰胜面约 85%。
one_liner_en: England are overwhelmingly stronger with a full-strength squad while Ghana are missing Kudus and in poor form; England's win probability is about 85%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距巨大：英格兰 2024 分（世界第 4）对加纳 1510 分（第 81），Davidson 统计基线已给英格兰约 82.6% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: Massive Elo gap: England 2024 (4th in the world) vs Ghana 1510 (81st); the Davidson statistical baseline already gives England about 82.6%.

key_reasons.cn: 加纳头号球星库杜斯伤缺整届世界杯，主力中卫吉库同样缺席，且热身赛 1 平 3 负状态低迷。
key_reasons.en: Ghana's star Mohammed Kudus is ruled out of the entire tournament and first-choice centre-back Alexander Djiku is also absent, on top of a 1-draw-3-loss warm-up run.

key_reasons.cn: 英格兰预选赛 8 战全胜、22 球 0 失球，6 月 6 日热身 1-0 胜新西兰，无重大伤停。
key_reasons.en: England won all 8 qualifiers with 22 goals and zero conceded, beat New Zealand 1-0 in the June 6 friendly, and have no major absences.

method_note: Market-blind: Elo (eloratings.net 2026-06-11) -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, no host bonus, neutral venue Boston) p_stat = 0.8255/0.1316/0.0428; bounded evidence adjustment (England +2.45pp, draw -1.66pp, Ghana -0.78pp; cap +/-8pp) for Kudus and Djiku absences vs England's clean squad and perfect qualifying; renormalized to p_final. No betting or prediction-market data used.
